Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Tanay - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavita - 38 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Tanay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Tanay: "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay starts crying.]

Kavita: "And then?"

[Tanay helps Mother get up.]

Tanay (happily): "One more time!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Tanay: "Show me too!"

[Tanay trips over a stone and falls.]

Tanay (surprised): "Careful!"

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Kavita (happily): "This is amazing!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Kavita: "I really enjoyed today."
